nodes.name: Normalize
nodes.notes: Maps HubSpot's own consent fields through when present. The platform does not block on them - an inherit_from_source campaign records the funnel origin instead - but a specific record beats an inferred one.

nodes.name: Platform Intake
nodes.notes: Idempotent on (tenant, source, event_id) - PRD 18.1. A retry returns the original outcome instead of creating a second lead.

nodes.name: Acknowledge
nodes.notes: Acknowledge fast so HubSpot does not retry on our processing time.
